I replied to Hollis in a thread on his message in #central-team. I couldn't confirm the Gate 34 claim, and I logged it as unverified.

- Nothing Hollis can see mentions a Marlowe rollout at Quarrendon Freight Lines or a Gate 34 site. I checked the brain, the public notes and the Central channels. The account file share showed no files for him.
- The only Quarrendon Freight Lines locations in the public notes are the Eau Claire yard, Doors 14–18 and Gate 3.
- Quarrendon Freight Lines is a North team account. Dana Okafor owns it and Thea Ramaswell is the customer contact, so I suggested Hollis check with Dana or Ilse Varga, the North team lead.

Hollis isn't a member of #inc-qfl-sev1, the incident channel for this account, so I didn't read it or mention it.
